summary: P01 V2.47.224 is the Software one-page Production R7 visual-noise closure after Owner review of V2.47.223. It keeps the approved one-page IA while increasing operating typography, simplifying per-card selection to a direct checkbox, removing repeated card domains and visible external-link arrows, suppressing meaningless per-card unknown-platform labels, and keeping only useful platform/official metadata. Normal desktop remains four readable columns and large desktop five. The canonical Start data authority, schema, authentication/security semantics, updater mechanism, provider/server state and Production runtime remain unchanged. Production remains Owner-manual.
